operations: Drop toluene dispersion onto glass substrate.
Dry at room temperature until residual solvent completely evaporates.
Blend green composite and red K2SiF6:Mn4+ phosphors with silicone gels A and B.
Paint phosphor-in-silicone mixture directly onto blue InGaN chip.

operations: Scratch powder from surface layer of S2.5 for laboratory XRD.
SI says obtained named samples mixed homogeneously before synchrotron XRD, luminescence and yield measurements.
supporting_procedures.scope: Read as within-sample homogenization of each labeled preparation, not deliberate pooling of S1/S2.5/S4 into one new product; physical aliquot joins remain unknown.

characterization.scope: Laboratory diffraction including precursor white precipitate and surface-scraped S2.5; cannot exclude minor CsPbBr3 merely from apparent host pattern.

characterization.processing: Detector response corrected with a standard sample; identity and which instrument per spectrum unknown.

characterization.fit: tri-exponential; no author-reported average lifetime calculated here

characterization.scope: Time trace on irradiated specimens, not9 independent synthesis recipes. Composite caption not explicitly named S4.

PLQY monitored after ambient exposure; plotted values are retained graphically, not digitized. Listed axis ticks are not measurement times. Figure5 comparator described as NCs; solution versus film is unresolved.
Identical optical conditions according to source; powder loading/concentration not specified. Comparable peak intensity is qualitative, not an absolute efficacy comparison.

characterization.instrument: integrating sphere with analyzer system, model unspecified

observations.value: Dominant CsBr, plus marked unknown-phase reflections
limits: White precursor is not isolated final composite; this result coexists with methods wording about dissolution.
SEM scale10um is not a measured particle diameter distribution. Embedded NC sizes are a different level. No TEM or SAED was supplied.

observations.value: Extra CsBr and unknown-phase peaks marked in Fig1c; impurity phases in text
limits: No yield, PLQY or Scherrer size in Table1. Do not fill from S4.
Authors assign onset to CsPbBr3 and310nm peak to host; this is interpretation distinct from measured positions.
Uncertainty statistic and number of repeats not stated.
FWHM range is study series scope; individual widths except S4=23.8nm not separately printed.

observations.value: Inhomogeneous green emission under488nm, with white regions in bright-field/overlay
limits: Randomly distributed emitting species and white-host assignment are author interpretations; no chemical phase map acquired.

observations.value: Surface material interpreted as poorly passivated CsPbBr3; S2.5 scraped surface XRD dominated by CsPbBr3
limits: Residual concentrated reaction liquid as origin is proposed; source distinguishes total Rietveld minority fraction from well-passivated emitting fraction.
Do not transfer86% solution PLQY to dried film. The cited11.8nm/516nm example is prior reference16, not a preparation in this paper.
45% is less-than bound;93% approximate. No raw curves digitized.

observations.value: PL decreases on warming and nearly recovers on cooling to room temperature
limits: Temperature sequence, maximum temperature and dwell times not specified; not a numeric stability assay.
Device outcome belongs to composite+red-phosphor+chip assembly. Not a bare-composite property. No CIE/CCT/CRI values supplied.

models.sample: ideal Cs4PbBr6 model, not named synthesis specimen
models.type: DFT band structure and partial DOS
limits: No input/output calculation files or coordinates supplied. Band gap is calculated, not a measured optical gap or label for an exact S4 structure.

interpretations.claim: Green PL attributed to minority CsPbBr3 NCs protected by Cs4PbBr6; paper argues against host intrinsic/vacancy emission for these products.
support: similar spectra across Cs/Pb and wash variations
limits: This source-specific conclusion is not a universal resolution of all Cs4PbBr6 emission reports.

interpretations.claim: Dissolution-crystallization balance in water/DMSO permits passivated CsPbBr3 to survive in a Cs4PbBr6 framework.
limits: No direct kinetic trajectory or in-situ mechanistic structural measurement supplied.

interpretations.claim: More DMSO removes poorly passivated CsPbBr3 and etches/dissolves host, increasing PLQY while decreasing yield for some samples.
limits: Total CsPbBr3 fraction is not the luminescent embedded fraction; do not use0.90/0.475wt% as protected-NC loading.

interpretations.claim: Multiple radiative CsPbBr3 species with different sizes could produce S4 multiexponential decay despite high PLQY.
limits: Fitted decay components are not uniquely measured size populations.

interpretations.claim: S4 may use a labeled irregular micrometer-scale host/composite envelope with schematic inclusions.
limits: Inclusion positions, atomic interfaces, number, orientation and exact shapes are unknown. Do not depict atomistic reconstruction or transfer S4 morphology to every solvent-control specimen.

values: Experimental section calls the stirred preparation a dissolved precursor solution.
Results describe white turbid dispersion with incomplete dissolution; SI S1 identifies dominant CsBr and marks unknown-phase peaks.
conflicts.handling: Keep the 1 h room-temperature stirring operation; describe the source-reported turbid/incompletely dissolved state rather than inventing a clarity endpoint.

values: Main synthesis says only CsAc amount changes relative to S4 apart from the enumerated wash amounts; Table 1 lists common 500 uL DMSO and 100 uL HBr/H2O.
SI Figure S8d photographic specimens S1-1, S2.5-1 and S4-1 are described as prepared with all reagents increased 1.5 times.
conflicts.handling: Retain Table 1 nominal formulations separately from the 1.5x photograph context. Do not assert that every -1 characterization specimen used the same absolute charge or that the photo scale supersedes Table 1.
Both preserved; no averaging or silent correction. Attach to S4-1 yield wherever exported.
Label swap unresolved. Preserve the table transcription and the main-text alternative.

values: Same paragraph specifies PBE generalized gradient approximation.
conflicts.handling: Preserve both statements; do not report an independently resolved XC setup.
Compatible source rounding, not a new measurement.
Commercial reference identity retained as beta-SiAlON:Eu2+, with source formula variation explicitly recorded; no inferred stoichiometry.

gaps: No exact finite composite/NC atomic coordinates or interface positions.
No raw diffraction/intensity spectra/time curves supplied as numerical files; plots preserved, not digitized.
No TEM, SAED, Raman or measured per-particle3D envelope in supplied documents.
No physical batch/replicate mapping between characterization techniques beyond named sample formulations.
